skill.blackbone.black_bone.tooltip: Always active. Take 20%% less damage. Unarmed melee hits from enemies reflect 10%% of the damage back to the attacker.
skill.blackbone.flow.tooltip: Every successful hit on an enemy builds 10%% Flow. At 100%% activate Flow (key G) to consume all stacks and gain Haste I and Strength I for 60 seconds, with glowing red eyes. Cannot be active together with Zone.
skill.blackbone.zone.tooltip: Every successful hit on an enemy builds 10%% Zone. At 100%% activate Zone (key H) to consume all stacks and gain Strength I and Resistance I for 60 seconds, with glowing electric blue eyes. Cannot be active together with Flow.
death.attack.blackbone_reflect: %1$s was hurt by their own strike
message.blackbone.other_active: Flow and Zone cannot be active at the same time
